title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Linden is an agency building travel apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Northhaven office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will improve app performance and stability, ship features end to end and own the release process.

A small, senior team. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
